Author: Castlerya

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 6,641Chapters: 2/?Kudos: 35

Summary: Getting evicted halfway through the semester wasn't part of your plans, so your survival strategy involves sleeping on one couch after another and getting by on unhealthy amounts of coffee. That is, until Stephanie mentioned that one of her brothers had a spare room in a building near the university. What Stephanie didn’t tell you was that her brother was ridiculously handsome—painfully so—and totally your type. And, of course, he has a girlfriend. Because apparently, finding a roof over your head was too easy without throwing in a little romantic mess.
